name: Edges
summary: LinkedIn and Sales Navigator data over REST: extract people, companies and posts, run searches, and find profile or company URLs.

api_key.description: An Edges API key (app.edges.run > Settings > Developers). Each user has their own key. Sent in the X-API-Key header.

notes: Every action takes a JSON body {input: {...}, parameters: {...}, identity_mode, identity_ids}. input holds the action's own fields (e.g. linkedin_profile_url).
An action runs on a LinkedIn account: your own connected identity (identity_ids, the default direct mode) or Edges' managed pool (identity_mode managed, extra credits). Without either the call fails.
Credits are charged per result returned (credit_ratio x results; most actions are 1). A run that returns nothing is free. GET /workspaces shows the balance.
These are the live endpoints, for one input and few results. Each action also has /run/async and /run/schedule variants that paginate for you and deliver by callback; not in this entry.
Write actions (connection requests, messages, InMail, visits, reactions), identities and integrations are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get workspace and credits
endpoints.summary: The workspace's plan, credits left, used and max, and billing period.

endpoints.name: Extract a LinkedIn profile
endpoints.summary: A person's profile: name, headline, location, job, and optionally experiences, education, skills and highlights.

parameters.description: Booleans, all default false: sections (education, languages, volunteering, summary, current company), experiences (partial list), skills (partial list), highlights (followers, connections, connection degree).

identity_mode.description: direct (default) runs on identity_ids; auto on any identity in the workspace; managed on Edges' pool of accounts, at an extra credit cost.

identity_ids.description: Identity UUIDs (user_uid, not account_uid) whose connected LinkedIn account runs the action; needed with direct mode.

notes: A read over POST, run live; charged per result returned.
